prompt.alinti: Get a finished logo, favicon, and app icons from your AI assistant.
It asks the right questions, then shows a few concepts and stops so you can pick one.
It tests your logo at tiny sizes and in one color.
It's handy if you're branding a new app alone.
Comment logo, and I'll send you the repo link.

yontem.ne: AI destekli logo tasarım sürecini otomatikleştirir.
yontem.alinti: A comprehensive logo-design skill that turns Claude (or any agent that supports AgentSkills such as Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) into a disciplined identity designer, from the first brief to production-ready SVG files and brand guidelines.
A reference library of 1,400+ real-world SVG logos, each visually classified by mark type, technique, typography, mood, and industry.

yontem.ne: Tasarımın logo ilkelerine uygunluğunu kontrol eder.
yontem.alinti: Dependency-free Python tools to audit an SVG against logo principles.

yontem.ne: 16px boyut testleri, tek renk, ters çevirme, squint, yansıma, kontekst ve rakip testleri içerir.
yontem.alinti: build concept overview sheets and test sheets (16px pixel test, one-colour, reversed, squint, mirror, contexts, competitors shelf test)

yontem.ne: Marka türü ve endüstriye göre kategorize edilmiş referanslar kullanılarak tasarım ilkeleri incelenir.
yontem.alinti: Used to study construction, map category conventions and avoid look-alikes (never to copy).

yontem.ne: Endüstriye özel mockup'lar ve sunum panelleri oluşturur.
yontem.alinti: create client presentation boards with industry-specific mockups.

yontem.ne: Tam favicon ve uygulama ikonları seti üretir.
